params.description: The parameters, which become controls when an instance gives no value.

min.description: The least value; with max, an instance without a value gets a range control.

title.description: The label of the control.

type.description: The field's type; f32 when absent.

keep.description: The versions that the app's step history keeps, thinned evenly over the run; 256 when absent.

struct.description: buffer: the name of the struct that the composer generates from fields.

sample.description: A small input for the preview.

data.description: The file's bytes in base64, when a command writes it; at most 1 MiB for all samples.

input.description: A tensor or buffer input of the piece.

path.description: The piece's folder relative to the workspace, pieces/<name>/<version>; null for a library or inline piece.

id.description: The program's id.

kept.description: The versions that the step history keeps.

first.description: The step of the oldest kept version.

last.description: The step of the newest kept version.

points.description: The points, in the model's order.

head.description: The head's index, or null for a module.

until_step.description: The step it ends before; it lasts until it is cleared when absent.

commands.name: intervene.set

pending.description: True: the intervention waits for the script's next step.

commands.summary: Sets one intervention on a point of the attached model, applied at the script's next step through the module hooks: ablate sets the point's output to zero, or one head's part where the point is a head. scale, steer and patch are reserved. It lasts until intervene.clear, or from from_step until until_step. The result says it is pending; a run event of change intervene reports the step the script applied it at. intervene.points lists the points.

all.description: true clears every intervention; point is then not given.

point.description: The point whose interventions to clear, from intervene.list.

cleared.description: The points whose interventions are cleared.

pending.description: True: the change waits for the script's next step.

commands.summary: Clears the interventions on one point of the attached model, or every intervention with all true, at the script's next step. The result names the points cleared and says the change is pending; a run event of change intervene reports the step the script applied it at.

since_step.description: The step the script applied it at, or null while it is pending.

state.description: pending until the script's next step, active, or ended after until_step.

until_step.description: The step it ends before, or null until it is cleared.

commands.summary: Lists the interventions on the attached model with their points, ops, step ranges and states: pending until the script's next step, active, or ended after their last step. It changes nothing.

commands.summary: Undoes the most recent change to the workspace, or the given number of steps. A step is one command, several commands sent with the same group, or a run of commands merged by a merge key, such as a slider drag. Undo restores the open spec and the saved loader recipes; it does not undo saving an applet or running a loader. Undo is the person's tool: the app's UI, the builder and programs over Caliper API may undo, and an agent may not; an agent takes back a change with an edit. history.list shows the steps first.
